description: The bar chart illustrates the correlation between knowledge popularity and LLM knowledge boundary perception across two domains—Movies and Songs—using four distinct categories represented by different colored bars: PopGT (orange), PopGe (light orange), RPopGT (blue), and RPopGe (blue with diagonal stripes). The vertical axis, labeled "Correlation," ranges from 0 to 0.7 in increments of 0.1, indicating the strength of the relationship. For the "Movies" category, PopGT shows a correlation of approximately 0.23, PopGe is around 0.09, RPopGT is about 0.35, and RPopGe reaches the highest value at approximately 0.63. In the "Songs" category, PopGT has a correlation of roughly 0.29, PopGe is around 0.08, RPopGT is approximately 0.48, and RPopGe peaks at about 0.68. The chart demonstrates that RPopGe consistently exhibits the highest correlation in both domains, followed by RPopGT, while PopGe consistently shows the lowest correlation. The bars are grouped by domain, with each group containing the four categories, and the legend in the upper right corner identifies the color and pattern corresponding to each category.
